title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned Product Study. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Product Study
options.lineage: a single sphere photographed in empty space
options.thesis: Callisto is one living orb on a quiet field; the name and sentence stay small and lowercase beneath it.
options.viewport: A modest orb in the upper third; callisto, then the operating sentence, then work / notes / contact as hairline links.
options.risk: Reads as a generic AI spinner if the dark side of the crescent is leftover black instead of designed absence.

raised.raise: Lintel beam: light travels across the orb like a lunar day, not a static highlight.
Anvil row: work and notes are single measured rows, not cards.
Title freeze: the orb is a freeze of a living body, not a looping spinner.
Live buffer: the mark is a running system, using thinking-orbs as the body.
Ghost segment: the unlit side of the crescent is drawn as carefully as the lit one.

options.label: Observatory Plate
options.lineage: scientific moon plates and captioned crater charts
options.thesis: Callisto as a studied specimen: circular field, caption, then a catalogue of operated bodies.
options.viewport: A circular plate centered like a moon chart; name and sentence as plate caption; work listed as numbered bodies below.
options.risk: Also the direction most runs in this category land on: space-brand quiet, familiar as a moon company.

options.label: Session Sleeve
options.thesis: The orb is cropped hard to one corner; a wide flat grey band carries the rest of the field.
options.viewport: Orb cropped to the upper left; lowercase callisto across the remaining field; work as title lines reversing out of the band.
options.case: Holds audience identification as a studio object; loses on product clarity because the crop fights the pinned mark-then-name reading order.
options.risk: Looks like album packaging when the crop is stylish instead of editorial.

options.label: Daylight Section
options.thesis: The site as rooms of traveling light, work gathered along the moving edge of warmth.
options.viewport: A long continuous section; the orb as a sun disk cutting rooms; work annotated to solar hours.
options.risk: Gold sunbeam breaks the grey/white/black brief and reads as architecture, not an operator studio.
options.case: Loses both axes: visitors do not identify with a building section, and the gold band hides the offer.
options.kept: Traveling light as the only active band.

options.label: Scale Shower
options.thesis: Each work entry is one blow: a full-width row that lengthens the metal.
options.viewport: One blow per row; force numerals; the orb as a cooling billet.
options.risk: Heat orange and industrial caps fight the quiet lowercase studio.
options.case: Loses both axes: brutal forging is not how this visitor identifies, and the heat color hides the sentence.
options.kept: One precise row per entry, measured like a strike.

options.label: Title Card
options.thesis: Hard color bars, colliding display type, the orb frozen as a silhouette.
options.viewport: A freeze-frame title; callisto crashing letters; work as episode numbers.
options.risk: Mustard and oversized caps violate lowercase modest type.
options.case: Loses both axes: the color flood and colliding caps erase the operator stance.
options.kept: The orb as a freeze of a living body, not a spinner.

options.label: Source Floor
options.thesis: The homepage is a running buffer; editing a line changes the orb.
options.viewport: A code buffer at stage scale; the orb as the audible pattern; work as layers.
options.risk: Nightlife code theater is not a studio letter, and neon breaks the palette.
options.case: Loses both axes: partners do not identify with a rave floor, and the offer becomes a demo.
options.kept: The mark is live and evaluated, not a PNG.

options.label: Segment Mask
options.thesis: Every glyph from one eight-cell mask; unlit segments are designed too.
options.viewport: Rigid digit slots; callisto forced into a clock mask; work as blinking modes.
options.risk: LED red and uppercase digits cannot set lowercase callisto.
options.case: Loses both axes: the mask cannot carry the name, and red glow fights the brief.
options.kept: Absence is drawn as carefully as light.

canonCard.label: Quiet studio colophon
canonCard.thesis: The category standard: centered lowercase, lots of air, three links, executed at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Centered mark, name, one sentence, work / notes / contact. What hf0-like studio sites ship.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
